Remark
[Topology of doubly warped completions]

Source: petersen:page-0041 ↗ prop:pet-ch1-doubly-warped-smooth-zero ↗ prop:pet-ch1-doubly-warped-smooth-b

If $\rho ,\phi $ are positive on $(0,\infty )$ and satisfy the conditions of subsection 4.5, the completed topology is $\mathbb {R}^{p+1}\times S^q$. On $[0,b]$, imposing the corresponding conditions at both endpoints produces $S^{p+1}\times S^q$. If instead $\rho $ collapses at one endpoint and $\phi $ at the other, the result is $S^{p+q+1}$.
